;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Papuan conflict]]
**Crowds gather in [[Port Moresby]], [[Papua New Guinea]], to show solidarity and to campaign for the freedom of [[West Papua (province)|West Papua]], which is under Indonesian control. Meanwhile, churches push the government of Papua New Guinea to take a firm stand on the situation. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/397395/papuan-students-in-java-urged-to-return-home-if-not-safe (Radio New Zealand)]
*[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces]] say their [[Israeli Air Force|Air Force]] strikes multiple [[Iran]]ian [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] targets in [[Aqraba, Syria|Aqraba]] near the [[Syria]]n capital [[Damascus]]. [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] claims an Iranian attack on Israel using armed drones to be imminent. Syria says it repels the attack and shoots down most of the attackers' rockets. [https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Explosions-heard-above-Damascus-599587 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://sana.sy/en/?p=171819 (SANA)]

;Disasters and accidents 
*[[2019 Brazil wildfires]]
**[[Brazil]] readies its [[Brazilian Armed Forces|military]] to fight wildfires in the [[Amazon rainforest]], but does not deploy troops. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2019/08/24/as-eu-threatens-trade-retaliation-brazil-fights-amazon-fires.html (CNBC)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/amazon-fires-troops-ready-1.5258906 (CBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Nauruan parliamentary election]]
**Voters in [[Nauru]] go to the polls to elect new members of [[Parliament of Nauru|parliament]]. [[President of Nauru|President]] [[Baron Waqa]] loses his parliamentary seat so he is not able to be re-elected in the office he has been holding since 2013. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-08-24/nauru-election-plagued-by-allegations-of-misconduct-opposition/11438708 (ABC News)] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-08-25/naurus-president-loses-bid-for-re-election/11446064 (ABC News)]
